entries.title: Five-dimensional collective Hamiltonian with improved inertial functions
entries.selection_reason: First microscopic implementation of the full 5D collective Hamiltonian (vibrational mass tensor D_betabeta, D_betagamma, D_gammagamma and rotational moments of inertia J_k) on the 2D (beta, gamma) deformation plane using Skyrme EDF (SkM*) via the Finite Amplitude Method (FAM-LQRPA). Solves the long-standing limitation of Inglis-Belyaev cranking and demonstrates strong coordinate-dependent time-odd enhancement in transitional nucleus 110Pd (A=110).
entries.access_boundary: Full text and complete LaTeX source package retrieved and verified locally from arXiv:2403.00214v1. Official published metadata verified via Crossref DOI: 10.1103/PhysRevC.109.L051301. Deep reading executed directly on original TeX sources.

entries.title: Moments of inertia of rare-earth nuclei and the nuclear time-odd mean fields within exact solutions of the adiabatic theory
entries.selection_reason: Presents a novel iterative fixed-point solver for the exact ATDHFB equations without inverting the two-body stability matrix. Systematically maps Thouless-Valatin vs Inglis-Belyaev moments of inertia across rare-earth isotopes (Gd, Dy, Er, Yb, Hf, W, Os; A=150-192, N=82-126) for SkM*, UNEDF1, and Gogny D1S. Disproves empirical constant enhancement factors and establishes strong linear correlation with isoscalar effective mass m*/m.
entries.access_boundary: Both v1 (arXiv:2502.07433v1) and latest v3 (arXiv:2502.07433v3) PDFs and complete LaTeX source archives retrieved and verified locally. Official publisher metadata verified via Crossref for PLB 868 (2025) 139685. Deep reading and text diff executed directly on TeX sources.

entries.title: Triaxial-shape dynamics in the low-lying excited 0+ state: Role of the collective mass
entries.selection_reason: Investigates the role of coordinate-dependent collective mass functions in 5DCH for 0_2+ and 2_2+ non-yrast states in gamma-soft N~28 (40Si, 42Mg, 44S) and N=78 (Xe, Ba) nuclei. Highly relevant for shape dynamics, but uses perturbative cranking inertia rather than self-consistent time-odd / LQRPA solvers; retained as supporting evidence for mass-dependent spectroscopy.
entries.access_boundary: Bibliographic reference and Crossref metadata only. Excluded from primary deep-read; not audited as full text.

entries.title: Thouless-Valatin rotational moment of inertia from linear response theory
entries.selection_reason: Pioneering application of zero-frequency FAM-QRPA to compute the Thouless-Valatin rotational moment of inertia in axial deformed rare-earth and actinide nuclei with Skyrme EDF. Excluded as primary study because it is restricted to 1D axial rotation and does not handle the triaxial (beta, gamma) 5DCH vibrational mass tensor.
entries.access_boundary: arXiv preprint 1801.07923 available open-access. Crossref verified.

entries.title: Thouless-Valatin moment of inertia and removal of the spurious mode in the linear response theory
entries.selection_reason: Focuses on the formal separation and projection of Nambu-Goldstone (spurious) rotational and translational zero-energy modes in linear response inertia calculations. Essential theoretical context for the counter-view critique, but excluded as primary paper due to conference summary format.
entries.access_boundary: Open access conference proceeding and arXiv:2004.14268v1 available.

entries.title: Large-amplitude quadrupole shape mixing probed by the (p, p') reaction
entries.journal: Progress of Theoretical and Experimental Physics
entries.selection_reason: Utilizes microscopic collective wavefunctions from the adiabatic self-consistent collective coordinate (ASCC) method / 5DCH to compute microscopic folded potentials and inelastic proton scattering for shape-mixed states in 24Mg, 28Si, 72Se. Excluded as primary paper because its primary focus is reaction cross-section folding rather than developing new collective inertia frameworks.
entries.access_boundary: Open access PTEP paper and arXiv:1906.01258 available.

entries.title: Shape coexistence in the neutron-deficient 188Hg investigated via lifetime measurements
entries.selection_reason: High-precision lifetime measurements in 188Hg benchmarking 5DCH against symmetry-conserving configuration mixing (SCCM/GCM). Demonstrates an experimental breakdown of the adiabatic 5DCH description across the sharp intruder crossing, where 5DCH fails to reproduce the prolate-oblate mixing matrix elements. Excluded as primary theory development because it is an experimental paper.
entries.access_boundary: Bibliographic reference and published PRC metadata only. Excluded from primary deep-read; not audited as full text.

entries.title: Shape and multiple shape coexistence of nuclei within covariant density functional theory: A five-dimensional collective Hamiltonian approach
entries.selection_reason: Global covariant DFT study (PC-PK1) of multiple shape coexistence in transitional nuclei (A~70, 100, 180) within 5DCH. Excluded as primary paper because it relies strictly on standard Inglis-Belyaev cranking and perturbative vibrational masses without time-odd mean-field response.

entries.title: Enhanced moments of inertia for rotation in neutron-rich nuclei
entries.selection_reason: Investigates time-odd mean fields and pairing dynamics in rotational moments of inertia for neutron-rich light-to-medium nuclei near drip lines. Excluded because its focus is spatial halo/skin neutron decoupling rather than transitional quadrupole collective motion in the A=60-190 core region.
entries.access_boundary: Open access PLB paper and arXiv:2208.06977 available.

entries.title: Symmetry conserving configuration mixing calculations of Zr isotopes
entries.selection_reason: Beyond-mean-field SCCM (GCM with simultaneous particle-number and angular-momentum projection) applied to the abrupt shape transition in 98-100Zr. Provides a rigorous GCM alternative that bypasses the Gaussian Overlap Approximation (GOA) and collective inertia tensors. Excluded from primary close reading because it does not compute collective Hamiltonian masses.
entries.access_boundary: Open access conference paper via EPJ Web of Conf.

entries.title: Finite-amplitude method for collective inertia in spontaneous fission
entries.selection_reason: Precursor FAM-QRPA formulation of collective inertia along spontaneous fission paths in heavy actinides (240Pu, 256Fm). Strictly excluded from selection per user constraint prohibiting superheavy fission as the main line.
entries.access_boundary: Open access arXiv:2011.05056 and PRC available.

entries.title: Exact solution of adiabatic time dependent Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov inertia for fission
entries.selection_reason: Examines exact solution of ATDHFB stability matrix and compares exact GCM inertia with cranking inertia, but focuses entirely on spontaneous fission paths in heavy systems. Strictly excluded per user constraint prohibiting fission as the main line.
